xml.brief: Activate a new account and log in

desc.p: Activates an account made with services/users/register (or on the website), with the code from the activation mail, as the website's activation page does.

The user chose the password in this application and has just proved the email address, so the application gets its Access Token for the user right away, without the authorize page. Only for applications the site's administrators allowed to register users, and only over HTTPS.
Refusals give HTTP 400 with a reason: unknown_email, already_active (log in through the usual OAuth flow then), wrong_code.

req.name: email
req.p: The email address the account was registered with.

req.name: code
req.p: The code from the activation mail (case and spaces don't matter).

ul.li: oauth_token, oauth_token_secret - the Access Token for this application and user (the same one the OAuth flow would give),
